finding.test_gap: ReplayResult.trades originated from broker exit-leg trade_log, while old valid-PnL loop had no nonempty assertion and no learner/ledger agreement.

implementation: ReplayEngine alone wires complete-position lookup to actual SimulatedBroker execution receipts; production DB lookup stays strict.
Fill receipts carry entry/order identity, simulated broker identity, modeled execution timestamp and sequence; pure conserved-cashflow validator is reused.
Per-broker random UUID namespace plus monotonic sequence preserves same-time execution ordering and avoids cross-run ID collision.
Terminal simulated rejections preserve order_id and explicit zero-execution receipts; replay-only verified-unfilled cleanup prevents rejected attempts from stalling subsequent outcomes.
Sell clipping and commissions use executed quantity, not requested oversized sell quantity.
Default ClosedPositionFills.price_source remains db_position_fills; replay returns simulated_position_fills, which paper evidence must not qualify.
ReplayResult preserves existing per-exit-leg trades and separately exposes accounted_trades plus accounting_pending.
nonvacuous_cases: buy6@100,sell2@101,sell4@99 -> one engine/learner -2 outcome; missing leg pending; repeat and engine restart no double count
pyramid weighted entry and oversized sell cashflow/commission use actual six executed shares
two flat lifetimes sharing one timestamp preserve order and identities
next-open modeled executed prices include spread/slippage in gross cashflow
real ReplayEngine.run wiring invokes actual reconciliation and consumer state; nonzero ledger count required
rejected first simulated entry does not block subsequent actual -2 close

tests.suite: new replay integration + pending close + fill accounting

limitations: Existing delay_fill means synchronous position mutation using next-bar-open price, not a queued delayed-execution lifecycle; adapter does not fix that pre-existing simulation lookahead model.
Engine restart is tested with the same broker receipt history; a fresh broker cannot reconstruct a previous run's missing executions, which remain explicitly pending.
No claim of paper execution fidelity or profitable strategy follows from replay adapter checks.
tests_unique_note: 78-case accounting run and36-case replay run overlap by8 new adapter cases; do not sum as114 distinct cases.
